turns.text: Hey Lloyd, the kitchen sink is leaking again. Can you remind me of the plumber's number?
Sure, it's 555-0199. Did you manage to turn off the main valve under the cabinet?
Yes, it's stopped. Anyway, I was reading up on some AI research today. Ming-Yu Liu discusses Physical AI learning across modalities.
That sounds like a broad topic. Is this for a paper you're writing or just general curiosity?
Just curiosity. I'm trying to understand how different data types interact. The weather here is surprisingly mild for July, though.
It is a bit unusual. I'll make a note to check the forecast for the rest of the week.
Thanks. Also, did I ever tell you about the dinner plans for Saturday?
You mentioned reservations at Luigi's for 7 PM.
Lloyd, my headphones are acting up. The left earbud has static. Any quick fixes?
Try resetting them by holding the power button for 10 seconds. Sometimes it's just a firmware glitch.
That worked, thanks. I've been digging deeper into that Ming-Yu Liu stuff. Specifically, Ming-Yu Liu discusses how Physical AI learns across language, video, and action.
Ah, so you're looking at the specific triad of modalities now. That clarifies the scope significantly.
Exactly. I need to cite this in my presentation next week. By the way, is the hardware order for the new SSDs shipped yet?
Yes, the tracking number was sent to your email this morning. It should arrive by Thursday.
Great. I also need to buy groceries. Do we have any milk left?
I don't have visibility into your fridge, but I can add milk to your shopping list if you'd like.
